title: The Capability Link: Does a Jailbroken Model Actually Know the Harmful Content?

original_idea.body: # The Capability Link. Probe ground-truth capability via benign framing and compare against jailbroken output quality to separate willingness from capability in misuse risk.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Separating willingness from capability refines misuse/uplift risk assessment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompting-based comparison of jailbroken vs benign-framed outputs; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused willingness-vs-capability comparison; judging harmful-content quality adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Methodological refinement with open models; labs underweight harm-measurement nuance.

novelty.reasoning: Capability-vs-willingness framing exists; explicit ceiling baseline plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Capability-baseline separation plausibly under-explored in jailbreak benchmarks.
